bare_minimum_action: Diarise and run short, documented review meetings with written feedback at set points, and make the keep/exit call before the minimum employment period ends
clock_trigger: Starts on start date; hard deadline = minimum employment period expiry (6 months, or 12 months for small business <15 employees)
cadence: At 1/3/5 months within the first 6/12 months
common_mistake: No cadence, no documentation, lose track of the date, "they seemed fine"
hot_water_later: Miss the window and the employee gains unfair-dismissal access: termination now needs a valid reason + procedural fairness + likely a PIP; notice can be up to 4-5 weeks vs 1; a quick month-5 decision becomes a months-long high-risk process; UD compensation cap up to $95,050 (FY2026-27)
fair_work_exposure: Unfair dismissal (FW Act Part 3-2); Small Business Fair Dismissal Code; NES notice s117
assistant_hook: Auto-reminders at 1/3/5 months + "minimum period ends in 30 days - decide now" alert; supply review + feedback template

bare_minimum_action: Set up 7-year employee records from day 1; issue a compliant, itemised payslip within 1 working day of each pay
clock_trigger: From day 1; each pay run (payslip within 1 working day)
common_mistake: Manual/informal records; bundling pay into one "gross" figure; missing allowance/penalty line items; gaps in leave/super/classification history
hot_water_later: In any underpayment dispute the reverse onus of proof shifts to the employer if records are inadequate - you effectively lose; civil penalties per contravention accumulate per employee per pay period
fair_work_exposure: FW Act s535-536 (records) & s536 (payslips); FW Regs 3.31-3.46; reverse onus in wage disputes
assistant_hook: Auto record-keeping checklist on hire; payslip required-field validator; 7-year retention timer

process: Annual Wage Review 1 July rate + allowance update
bare_minimum_action: Update base rates and allowances to the new award rates from the first full pay period on/after 1 July
clock_trigger: Each 1 July (annual)
common_mistake: Set-and-forget pay rates; missing the 1 July uplift; forgetting allowances also move
hot_water_later: Underpayment accrues from 1 July across the whole workforce; strict-liability back-pay + penalties; compounds silently until an audit or claim
fair_work_exposure: Award minimum rates (s45 FW Act); Annual Wage Review
assistant_hook: Annual 1 July alert + new-rate diff per classification

bare_minimum_action: Pay SG so it is RECEIVED by the employee's fund within 7 business days of each payday
clock_trigger: Each payday (day 0); 7-business-day deadline (from 1 July 2026)
common_mistake: Still on the quarterly mindset; paying late; treating "sent" as "received"; missing the new-employee 20-day rule
hot_water_later: Super Guarantee Charge applies (non-deductible interest + admin fee) on late/short payments; faster-triggering exposure than the old quarterly system; loss of tax deductibility for late SG
fair_work_exposure: SG law; Payday Super regime (Treasury Laws Amendment (Payday Superannuation) Act 2025; commenced 1 July 2026)
assistant_hook: Payday-linked super timer; 7-business-day countdown per pay run; new-employee 20-day-rule flag

bare_minimum_action: File-note every performance/conduct conversation at the time; sequence any adverse action carefully relative to any workplace right the employee has exercised
clock_trigger: At each incident/conversation; before any adverse action
common_mistake: No feedback trail; "they knew"; reconstructing notes after the fact; acting right after a complaint or leave request
hot_water_later: No documentation means no defensible PIP or dismissal - drives avoidable unfair-dismissal losses; ill-timed action after a workplace right triggers general protections (reverse onus on the employer; no compensation cap; no minimum employment period)
fair_work_exposure: Unfair dismissal (Part 3-2); general protections / adverse action (Part 3-1; s340-361 reverse onus)
assistant_hook: Prompt to log after 1:1s; file-note template; "adverse-action risk-check before you act" gate

bare_minimum_action: Track each casual's tenure; when a valid employee-choice notification arrives, respond in writing within 21 days (accept, or refuse on valid grounds)
clock_trigger: Eligibility at 6 months (non-small) / 12 months (small business <15); 21-day response clock on any notification
common_mistake: Not tracking tenure; assuming a regular fixed shift pattern is still casual; ignoring/late/invalid refusal
hot_water_later: Misclassification exposes back-pay of leave and entitlements; Fair Work Commission dispute; civil penalties for a non-compliant refusal or failure to respond in time
fair_work_exposure: s15A casual definition; Employee Choice Pathway; 21-day response obligation
assistant_hook: Tenure tracker with 6/12-month flag; 21-day response timer + valid-grounds refusal template

bare_minimum_action: Record the components the salary covers + outer-limit hours; reconcile actual hours/penalties against the salary each pay period and annually, and top up any shortfall
clock_trigger: Each pay period + an annual reconciliation
common_mistake: Set-and-forget salary at hire; assuming a "good salary" covers everything; never re-checking against actual rostered hours
hot_water_later: Underpayment even on an above-market salary if actual hours/penalties in a period exceed the pro-rata salary; Woolworths-style remediation; back-pay + penalties; flagged FWO enforcement priority
fair_work_exposure: Annualised wage award clauses (in force since 1 Mar 2020); s45 FW Act
assistant_hook: Per-pay-period reconciliation calculator + annual reconciliation reminder

bare_minimum_action: Complete award/agreement consultation and genuinely consider redeployment BEFORE the decision is finalised or implemented
clock_trigger: Before the decision is implemented; award consultation-clause trigger
common_mistake: Deciding first and "consulting" after; skipping consultation; using redundancy to remove an underperformer
hot_water_later: Even a genuine redundancy can be an unfair dismissal if consultation/redeployment was skipped; back-pay if award/contract redundancy pay was owed; a role reappearing shortly after is a red flag
fair_work_exposure: NES redundancy (s119-121); modern-award consultation clause; genuine redundancy test (s389)
assistant_hook: "Consult before you decide" gate; consultation letter + timeline; redeployment checklist

bare_minimum_action: Verify work rights via VEVO before commencement and keep a dated record
clock_trigger: Before commencement (make offer conditional on it)
cadence: Per hire (+ re-check before visa expiry)
common_mistake: Skipped, assumed, or done after the person starts; no record kept
hot_water_later: Employer sanctions/penalties for employing an unlawful non-citizen; without a dated due-diligence record there is no defence
fair_work_exposure: Migration Act employer sanctions; VEVO verification
assistant_hook: Pre-start VEVO checklist; visa-expiry re-check timer for temporary-visa holders

process: Written contract issued & signed before start
bare_minimum_action: Issue a compliant written contract (award, classification, set-off, hours, employment type) for signature before day 1
clock_trigger: Before commencement
common_mistake: Verbal offers; contract issued after start or never; silent on hours/classification
hot_water_later: Sub-minimum terms are void (back-pay); no valid set-off to rely on; casual/fixed-term status disputes; later "what did we actually agree" disputes with no anchor
fair_work_exposure: Contract cannot undercut NES/award (offending terms void); interplays with s15A (casual) and s333E (fixed-term)
assistant_hook: Contract-before-start gate; template by employment type with set-off clause

bare_minimum_action: Track fixed-term tenure and renewals; give the FTCIS at each new/renewed contract; stay within the 2-year / one-renewal limits
clock_trigger: At each offer/renewal; 2-year cumulative cap (since 6 Dec 2023)
common_mistake: Rolling 12-month "trial" contracts; forgetting the FTCIS; not counting back-to-back contracts cumulatively
hot_water_later: The offending term is of no effect and the role can become permanent by operation of law; civil penalties for FTCIS non-provision and for deliberate avoidance structuring
fair_work_exposure: FW Act s333E-333N; Fixed Term Contract Information Statement
assistant_hook: Fixed-term register with cumulative-tenure + renewal-count flag; FTCIS auto-attach on each contract

process: Contractor-vs-employee classification at engagement & on change
bare_minimum_action: Assess the true nature (whole-of-relationship test) at engagement and re-check when the relationship changes; document the reasoning
clock_trigger: At engagement; test is dynamic/ongoing
cadence: On engagement + on any material change
common_mistake: "They invoice us, so they're a contractor"; never re-checking as the relationship deepens
hot_water_later: Misclassification exposes unpaid NES, super guarantee charge (up to 200%), PAYG, and sham-contracting penalties (up to $19,800 individual / $99,000 small business / greater of $495,000 or 3x underpayment for larger)
fair_work_exposure: s15AA whole-of-relationship test; s357 sham contracting; contractor high-income opt-out $190,100 (from 1 Jul 2026)
assistant_hook: Classification questionnaire at engagement; re-assessment prompt on scope change; opt-out-notice flag above $190,100

process: Fair Work + Casual Employment Information Statements on commencement
bare_minimum_action: Give the Fair Work Information Statement to every new employee (and the Casual Employment Information Statement to casuals) on or before commencement
clock_trigger: On commencement (s125); CEIS also at 6/12-month intervals
common_mistake: Forgotten in onboarding; no record it was provided
hot_water_later: Civil penalty for non-provision; compounds evidentiary weakness in any later dispute
fair_work_exposure: NES s125 (FWIS); Casual Employment Information Statement
assistant_hook: Onboarding auto-attach both statements + logged acknowledgement; CEIS interval reminders

bare_minimum_action: Give the standard choice form; if no choice is made, request the stapled fund from the ATO before paying to a default fund
clock_trigger: Within 28 days of start; before any default-fund payment
common_mistake: Paying to a default fund without doing the stapled-fund check
hot_water_later: Choice-of-fund shortfall penalties; additional SGC exposure
fair_work_exposure: Super choice-of-fund + stapled-fund rules (ATO)
assistant_hook: Stapled-fund check step in onboarding; 28-day timer

process: Long service leave accrual tracking from start
bare_minimum_action: Record the continuous-service start date and accrue LSL per state/territory rules from day 1
clock_trigger: From start date; state qualifying period + pro-rata triggers on termination
common_mistake: No tracking; start date lost; ignoring pro-rata entitlement on early termination
hot_water_later: Back-pay of the LSL entitlement + state penalties; pro-rata payout owed on termination (e.g. NSW after 5 years) miscalculated or missed
fair_work_exposure: State/territory LSL Acts (NSW LSL Act 1955; VIC LSL Act 2018; QLD IR Act 2016)
assistant_hook: Service-date clock per employee; state-rule engine; pro-rata alert on exit

process: Flexible-work request - written response within 21 days
bare_minimum_action: Discuss and genuinely try to agree, then respond in writing within 21 days; if refusing, document specific reasonable business grounds
clock_trigger: 21 days from the written request
common_mistake: Informal/verbal refusal; "we're too small to accommodate that"; no written response inside the window
hot_water_later: The Fair Work Commission can order the request granted or make a different determination if the process was not followed; the refusal is now arbitrable
fair_work_exposure: FW Act s65-65A (flexible work requests; FWC arbitration powers)
assistant_hook: 21-day response timer on a logged request; reasonable-grounds template + alternatives-considered log

bare_minimum_action: Maintain a policy + training + reporting pathway proactively (not just react to complaints) - the AHRC 7 Standards scaled to business size
clock_trigger: Ongoing proactive duty (positive duty since Dec 2022; AHRC enforcement powers since 12 Dec 2023)
common_mistake: Reactive "we'll deal with it if someone complains"; no policy or training record
hot_water_later: AHRC inquiries, compliance notices, court-ordered compliance and enforceable undertakings; vicarious liability for harassment that occurs
fair_work_exposure: Sex Discrimination Act positive duty (Respect@Work); AHRC enforcement
assistant_hook: Policy + training-refresh cadence reminders; 7-Standards self-check

bare_minimum_action: Identify-assess-control-review psychosocial hazards with a documented register; consult workers; review periodically and after incidents
clock_trigger: Ongoing duty; review on change or incident
common_mistake: No documented process; treating it as an EAP/wellbeing nice-to-have; no worker consultation
hot_water_later: WHS penalties (severe; officer imprisonment for reckless conduct in most jurisdictions); improvement/prohibition notices; NO small-business size carve-out
fair_work_exposure: WHS Act primary duty of care; Managing Psychosocial Hazards Codes of Practice
assistant_hook: Psychosocial hazard register template; periodic review reminder; incident-triggered reassessment

bare_minimum_action: Apply the correct NES (or award/contract) notice scale by tenure; pay all accrued entitlements; meet state final-pay timing
clock_trigger: At termination
common_mistake: Flat notice regardless of tenure; forgetting the extra week for over-45s with 2+ years' service; unpaid accrued leave; assuming the small-business redundancy exemption also removes notice
hot_water_later: An underpayment dispute layered on top of any dismissal claim; 1 week vs up to 4-5 weeks' notice; FWO recovery + superannuation on top
fair_work_exposure: NES notice of termination (s117); correct final pay
assistant_hook: Tenure-based notice calculator; final-pay checklist incl. accruals + state timing

bare_minimum_action: Record job-relevant reasons for each shortlist/reject decision and use structured, lawful questions at the time
clock_trigger: At each screening/interview decision
common_mistake: Gut-feel decisions; no notes; unlawful (protected-attribute) questions; can't reconstruct why later
hot_water_later: A discrimination claim with no contemporaneous, defensible record - the reasoning has to be built after the fact when it is least credible
fair_work_exposure: Anti-discrimination law (Cth + state); AHRC
assistant_hook: Structured scorecard + reason capture; unlawful-question guardrail at interview

bare_minimum_action: Update the privacy collection notice to disclose automated decision-making used in hiring before the 10 Dec 2026 commencement
clock_trigger: Hard date: 10 December 2026
common_mistake: Not tracking the commencement date; no ADM disclosure in the privacy/collection notice
hot_water_later: OAIC enforcement under the amended Privacy Act; separate discrimination exposure if AI screening produces discriminatory outcomes
fair_work_exposure: Privacy Act automated-decision-making transparency (commences 10 Dec 2026)
assistant_hook: Countdown to 10 Dec 2026; privacy-notice ADM-disclosure clause template
